title: Graduate Analyst Programme - Products & Services
description:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence - all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly - all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a  Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Graduate Analyst Programme

Our Graduate Analyst role offers the opportunity to start and grow your career at Baringa. As a permanent member of our team from day one, you'll work on a variety of real client and internal projects, develop valuable skills, and make a meaningful contribution from the outset.

You'll work alongside experienced consultants, building both your technical and professional capabilities through structured learning, hands-on experience, and ongoing development opportunities. Along the way, you'll build relationships across the business, collaborate with colleagues from different teams and sectors, and contribute to work that makes a real impact.

If you're a recent graduate looking to kick-start your career, Baringa offers a supportive and collaborative environment where you can develop your skills, gain practical experience, and build a successful long-term future with us.

We're looking for Graduate Analysts to join our Products & Services practice, with opportunities available across several of our specialist business units. During the application process, you'll have the opportunity to select the business unit that best aligns with your interests and aspirations.

The business units currently hiring are:

Technology, Media & Telecoms

Customer expectations are in flux. Commerce straddles the physical and digital worlds. Inflation is fuelling economic uncertainty. Supply chains are stretched. And sustainability is in the spotlight. In these exceptional times, we use our deep industry knowledge and pragmatic transformation experience to help consumer products and retail companies transform to remain relevant today and thrive into tomorrow.  

Desired Skills: Structured problem solving, Data analysis and modelling, Digital and AI literacy, Team collaboration and personal communication

Desired Degrees: Supply Chain, Business, Operations Management

Industrial Manufacturing

We partner with our Manufacturing clients to shape the future - securely, sustainably, and at scale. Our team bring expertise in industrial performance, operational resilience, and the transformation of complex manufacturing ecosystems. title: Senior Marketing Analytics Manager - BI & Data Architecture
description:

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara , we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing - and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Are you passionate about building robust data architectures that power next-generation, AI-driven business intelligence? Do you thrive in the intersection of data engineering and analytics, wearing both hats to design scalable backends and deliver actionable insights?

In this role, you will work closely with our Marketing, Sales, and Data Engineering teams to build the foundational "Gold Layers" and semantic models that enable self-serve reporting and agentic AI workflows.

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact-helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

•

•
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.

•

Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed - we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. title: Mission Support Specialist - Munitions
description:
About Virtualitics

Virtualitics is the category leader in AI-native readiness applications for defense, government, and critical infrastructure. Founded on a decade of Caltech research in partnership with NASA/JPL, we are led by scientists, strategists, and servicemembers united by a single mission: to solve the world’s most complex, mission-critical challenges with AI.

Our Readiness AI solutions deliver operational certainty - giving leaders and operators a clear picture of what’s ready, what’s at risk, and what to do next. By identifying risks early, diagnosing root causes, and recommending prioritized actions with transparent, explainable AI, we help organizations move from data complexity to decision advantage.

Behind that impact is relentless innovation. Inventors at heart, we hold 15+ U.S. patents and are leading the shift toward agent-driven readiness. But what truly sets us apart is our culture - relentless about results, grounded in transparency, and driven by compassion for the mission and the people it serves.

If you’re motivated by impact, inspired by technical depth, and ready to build AI that performs where it matters most - you’ll find your mission here.

Location: Remote, with up to 50% travel to assigned customer locations. Candidates residing near an Air Force base are highly preferred.

This position will work on Department of War munitions related projects. You must be authorized to work in the US without sponsorship with the ability to obtain a security clearance, which is issued by the U.S. government. U.S. citizenship is required by the DoW and IC for security clearance.

*Secret clearance required

What You Will Be Doing

• Support the Solution Leader with providing munitions subject matter expertise to deliver training and enablement for the Virtualitics Readiness AI platform

• Serve as an embedded Virtualitics representative traveling to multiple customer sites, assisting the Solution Leader with the day to day relationship with end users and acting as the primary training and enablement point of contact

• Provide customer with technical operational knowledge to leverage the Virtualitics AI products to obtain mission value

• Act as the customer advocate within Virtualitics by representing the customer’s needs, escalating pain points through daily touchpoints with engineering and product teams, and ensuring a positive customer experience

• Deliver hands-on training and enablement as the subject matter expert for customer mission integration, working alongside mission teams in a variety of formats

• Coordinate on-site technical operations with the Virtualitics Solution Leader (both on-site and remote) for platform data insight capabilities

• Collect, analyze, and report customer feedback and ground truth; as the most forward-deployed representative of Virtualitics , you observe what’s working and what’s not and ensure that information flows back to the company

• Assist the Solution Leader for planning required onsites with the customer e.g., office space, equipment readiness, logistics, scheduling, and resource coordination

• Assist Solution Leader with customer classified engagements. Drive adoption of Virtualitics Readiness AI solutions through persistent, relationship-driven engagement with end users

• Uphold Virtualitics ’ brand, image, and values through professional conduct and consistent service delivery

• Support personnel compliance tracking including clearance status, NDA completion, CAC management, and training requirements

What We Are Looking For

• 5+ years of experience working in or directly supporting Department of War munitions operations

• Demonstrated technical aptitude, comfortable with data platforms, analytics tools, and translating technical capabilities into operational outcomes

• Experience operating autonomously in demanding environments with minimal supervision; this role requires the judgment and initiative of an experienced SNCO or O-3/O-4 officer with munit

title: Go Applications Engineer
description:
Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Go Application Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $130,000-$145,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced Go Application Engineer to design and build high-performance backend services, infrastructure tooling, and cloud-native applications using Go. In this role you will work on systems where latency, concurrency, and operational efficiency are first-class concerns, and you will contribute to a codebase shared by engineers across multiple teams. The ideal candidate will combine strong Go expertise with broad systems knowledge, including network programming, container ecosystems, and distributed system design. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners - product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders - to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Required Qualifications

• Five or more years of professional software engineering experience, with significant time in Go.

• Strong understanding of Go concurrency patterns (goroutines, channels, contexts).

• Hands-on experience building production gRPC and/or REST APIs in Go.

• Experience with Kubernetes-native development (client-go, controller-runtime).

• Solid experience with relational and key-value data stores.

• Strong understanding of distributed systems and networking fundamentals.

• Experience with CI/CD pipelines and container-based deployment.

• Excellent debugging and performance-engineering skills.

• Strong communication and documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Open-source contributions to Go-based projects.

• Experience writing Kubernetes operators or controllers.

• Familiarity with eBPF, service mesh, or low-level systems programming.

• Exposure to security-sensitive Go projects (cryptography, auth).

• Experience with WASM, Tinygo, or embedded systems.

title: Test Automation Engineer
description:
We're looking for a Test Automation Engineer to join our Agile engineering team at Nagarro . You’ll help build reliable, high-quality software by creating and improving automated tests and testing frameworks. Working closely with developers and requirements teams, you’ll drive testability, challenge acceptance criteria, and help catch issues early. Your day-to-day work will focus on Python, Behave, Playwright, API testing, and automated unit/integration testing in a modern engineering environment.

• Design, implement, review, and execute automated test cases and test scenarios, with a strong focus on API and end-to-end testing.

• Develop and maintain automated tests using Python, Behave, and Playwright , as well as improve the existing test automation framework.

• Analyze failed test cases, identify root causes, and create defects when appropriate.

• Create and maintain regression and smoke test suites, test data, test environments, and test clients.

• Collaborate closely with developers and Software Requirement Leads to analyze testability, challenge acceptance criteria, and ensure effective test coverage.

• Execute automated and manual integration tests and contribute to the continuous improvement of testing processes and CI/CD test pipelines.

• 3+ years of experience in software testing and test automation , preferably within an Agile environment.

• Strong practical knowledge of Python and experience developing automated test cases.

• Experience with BDD/TDD , ideally using Behave , and maintaining or improving test automation frameworks.

• Hands-on experience with Playwright using Python for API and end-to-end testing.

• Experience with API testing , with gRPC being highly desirable; REST API testing experience is also valuable.

• Good analytical, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with developers, testers, and requirements teams.

👋🏼 We're Nagarro . We are a digital product engineering company that is scaling in a big way! We build products, services, and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. Can you help your teammates proceed in the right direction? Can you tackle the challenges our clients face while always looking to take our solutions one step further to succeed at an even higher level? Yes? You may be ready to join us.

title: Python Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
This is a general track role, hiring for every team at Canonical who works in Python, across all levels of seniority. Apply here if you believe you are already an outstanding Python engineer.
Canonical works across the entire open source spectrum. Canonical Ubuntu is well-known as a developer favourite and enterprise-friendly Linux. Our web services and system utilities are often written in Python, which we choose where collaboration with other teams, ecosystems and communities is more important than raw performance.

Why this role exists
Most enterprises don't have a cloud and AI cost problem. They have a deployment problem. They may already know their GPU fleet is oversubscribed, their inference bill is compounding, or parts of their estate are running inefficiently. What they often lack is someone who can walk into a risk-averse engineering organization, identify the highest-leverage change, solve the technical problem deeply enough to earn credibility, and get the change into production.
That is this job. Not analysis - optimization deployment.
We are hiring Sr Deployment Strategists because the constraint is no longer simply finding inefficiency. It is landing the fix inside a real organization, with real approval gates, tribal knowledge, and engineers who may not have asked for a vendor's opinion. You will own that journey from the first workshop through production change and measurable business impact.
What you'll own
Scope

• Partner with executive sponsors - CTO, VP Infrastructure, VP Engineering, Head of AI Platform - to turn ambiguous mandates into concrete, time-boxed deployments with a defensible business case.

Own the outcome

• Define adoption and impact metrics before deployment and hold yourself accountable to them.

• Own the executive narrative from kickoff through handoff, translating business outcomes into technical implementation and technical constraints back into business decisions.

• Design POC scope, success criteria and the graduation path into production, and own the case for expansion alongside the account team.

• Identify additional optimization opportunities as you learn the client's environment.

Make the organization better

• Turn field learnings into reusable playbooks so the next deployment starts further ahead.

• Push product gaps, integration friction and recurring client pain back into Helias with enough technical specificity to influence the roadmap.

• Operate collaboratively and independently: support the expansion of the team, remove obstacles without waiting for hand-holding, and consistently work toward the outcome.

Deep technical problem-solving and cloud infrastructure credibility - non-negotiable

About the role

As the GTM Enablement Trainer, Claude Products, you'll teach Anthropic's global field organization how to use our products, both to do their own work better and to position Claude credibly with customers. Anthropic ships quickly, and the surface area of what we build is growing faster than any individual seller can track. The job has two halves. The first is enabling our own people to be power users of Claude, so the field is the most sophisticated user of the product we sell. The second is enabling them to position it: to run a credible technical conversation with a customer, anticipate the hard questions, and hold their own with a technical buyer.

The best person in this role sees around corners. You won't wait for a launch to be announced before you start building enablement for it. You'll be embedded enough with Product and Applied AI to know what's coming, and opinionated enough to say which surfaces need real enablement investment and which don't. title: Lead AI System Architect
description:
The AI System Architect leads the architecture of EIS's agentic AI platform - the design of multi-agent systems that automate insurance workflows end-to-end across Policy, Billing, and Claims domains. The role owns the patterns, frameworks, and standards for agent orchestration, MCP-based tool ecosystems, agent memory, planning, evaluation, and safety. RAG and conversational features are table stakes; the forward agenda is autonomous and semi-autonomous agents that act on behalf of users - quote intake, claims triage, underwriting and pricing intelligence, billing troubleshooting, and beyond - across our platform and technology stacks.
Key Responsibilities

• Own the architecture of EIS's agentic platform: agent orchestration, MCP-native tool ecosystems, agent memory (short-term, long-term, semantic), planning, and tool/function calling patterns reusable across product domains.

• Enable and provide support for domain teams for vertical insurance agents and the horizontal capabilities (RAG, retrieval, instructional flows) they compose from.

• Define and enforce levels of autonomy - assistive, semi-autonomous, autonomous - with explicit human-in-the-loop checkpoints, escalation paths, and reversibility for high-stakes actions in regulated workflows.

• Drive the MCP strategy: which capabilities EIS exposes as MCP servers to internal and partner agents, how our agents consume external MCP tools, and the tool registry, schemas, and versioning that keep this scalable.

• Maintain the multiple stack approach as a first-class capability: Typescript, and Java. Help teams to pick the right stack per agent and keep all aligned through shared configuration artefacts, prompt management, and evaluation tooling.

• Lead Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) for agentic capabilities; partner with Platform, Security/InfoSec, and DevOps so agents are observable, testable, sandboxed, and compliant by default.

• Drive AI DevOps for agents: trace capture and replay, eval harnesses (task success, tool-use correctness, regression), prompt and model versioning, cost and latency budgets per agent, and progressive rollout strategies.

• Set safe-AI standards for agentic systems: prompt injection and tool-poisoning defenses, action allow-lists, blast-radius controls, PII handling, data residency, and bias mitigation. Treat agent safety as a first-class architectural concern.

• Translate insurance use cases into production agent designs with product strategists and domain architects; provide technical leadership and mentorship; communicate agentic trade-offs (autonomy, reliability, cost, safety) clearly to executives, customers, and engineers.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

• Proven track record designing and shipping agentic systems in production - not demos, not prototypes - with meaningful autonomy and multi-step tool use.

• Strong systems background: data-intensive, distributed, and latency-sensitive design in production environments.

• Deep, hands-on experience with agent patterns: orchestration, planning, ReAct-style and graph-based agents, agent memory, tool/function calling, MCP, structured outputs. Sharp instinct for when an agent is the right answer and when a deterministic workflow is. Tracks the frontier and translates what matters into the roadmap.

• Strong with the Java/Spring ecosystem.

• Strong with Typescript and Python for AI (LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent agent framework) - production experience required. Equally comfortable in both stacks.

• Hands-on with vector databases including embedding models, hybrid search, re-ranking, and retrieval evaluation.

• Experience with agent evaluation and observability: traces, replays, eval harnesses, guardrails, and cost/latency telemetry. Familiar with AI configuration-as-code.

• Experience shipping AI services on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) in regulated enterprise environments - security review, data residency, audit trails.

• Familiarity with insurance, financial service

title: Builder
description:
About SafeLease

At SafeLease , we're rethinking how P&C insurance is sold in an age of technological change. We believe the industry's biggest inefficiencies aren't technical problems - they're structural ones. And we're building the team to tackle them.
SafeLease is a profitable insurance business that designs, underwrites, and distributes specialty coverage for commercial property owners and their tenants. Most insurance companies either distribute products or bear the risk - we do both. We back our policies with our own capital, which means we control the full stack: product design, tech, and the speed at which we move. That end-to-end ownership lets us offer customers real flexibility, saving time and money for more than 4,000 properties insured for billions in value nationwide.
We're a team of 85, growing over 100% annually, and we've done it without sacrificing profitability or culture. Here, you'll get high discretion and a wide aperture of problems to solve. We embrace the newest technologies, move fast together, and operate with the intensity of a small company where every person's work is visible. If you're looking for a place to sharpen your craft alongside people who take their work seriously, you'll fit right in.
Why "Builder"?
The best people on our team start with a business problem, figure out what should exist to solve it, and then build it, often end-to-end. They talk to stakeholders, sketch out solutions, make product and design decisions, write the code, and ship it. They use AI tools not as a novelty but as a core part of how they work. The line between "product thinking" and "engineering" isn't one they spend much time drawing.
We call this role Builder because that's what it actually is. You'll work in small pods with a GM who sets direction, but how you get there and what you build along the way is largely up to you.
If you're looking for a well-defined backlog and a narrow lane, this probably isn't the right fit. If you want the autonomy to solve real problems and the context to understand why they matter, keep reading.
About the Role
To drive our mission forward, this role will:

• Start with the problem, not the ticket. Understand the business context behind what you're building. Know why it matters to customers, to the business, and to the team.

• Own outcomes, not just output. Take features from idea to production. That means participating in product and design decisions, not waiting for a spec to land in your lap.

• Build across the full stack. Write clean, maintainable code across frontend, backend, and infrastructure with a focus on reliability, performance, and simplicity.

• Use AI as a force multiplier. Leverage AI-powered tools to move faster, explore solutions more broadly, and spend your time on the problems that actually require human judgment.

• Improve the system, not just your code. Identify opportunities to make the platform better, the team faster, and the product sharper. Bring ideas, not just implementations.

• Collaborate with high context. Work closely with your pod, leadership, and cross-functional partners. Share what you know, ask what you don't.

About You
You're a problem solver who happens to write code, not the other way around. You care about what gets built as much as how it gets built. You're comfortable with ambiguity, energized by ownership, and sharp enough to develop a working understanding of the business you're building for.
Your experience:

• 2-5+ years of experience in full-stack software development with a track record of shipping real-world applications

• Background in CS/EE, a coding bootcamp, or equivalent hands-on experience building production systems

• Proficiency across Frontend (TypeScript, JavaScript, React), Backend (Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs), and Infrastructure (relational databases, Git, AWS)

• Demonstrated fluency with AI-powered development tools (Cursor, Claude, Copilot, etc.) - not just awareness, but active use in your workflow

title: Senior Manager, Royalty Administration & Onboarding
description:
Established in 2015, Create Music Group is a leading music and entertainment company. The company operates as a record label, distribution company, and entertainment network which generates over 15 billion music streams each month on DSP’s. Named #2 on the Inc 5000 Fastest Growth Companies in America in 2020, the company has grown exponentially by leveraging its owned IP with its media and technology platform. The company works with superstar artists, major and independent record labels, and global media brands. It operates a number of companies including Label Engine, one of the largest independent music distribution platforms in the world, with over 75,000 artists and 5,000 label clients; and Flighthouse, a digital entertainment brand focused on Gen Z, which has more than 300 million followers across social media. Create Music Group is based in Hollywood, CA and has 400 employees worldwide.

Job Summary

At Create Music Group , acquiring a catalog is only the beginning. The next step is turning each acquisition into a fully operational royalty business - accurately configured, scalable, and built to serve artists, partners, and rightsholders for the long term.

The Senior Manager, Royalty Administration & Onboarding plays a critical role in making that happen. This leader oversees the royalty onboarding strategy for newly acquired catalogs, translating complex deal terms into clear, effective royalty structures and workflows across Create’s systems. From interpreting acquisition agreements to designing the future-state setup, this role ensures every catalog is positioned for accurate and efficient royalty administration from day one.

As a key partner to our M&A, Finance, Legal, and Royalties teams, the Senior Manager is involved early in the acquisition lifecycle-including during diligence-to identify royalty requirements, surface potential gaps, and help shape a seamless transition into Create’s platform. The role works closely with the Director of Royalties and leads a growing team responsible for bringing each onboarding strategy to life.

This is an opportunity to sit at the intersection of music rights, acquisitions, operations, and technology at a company that continues to expand its global catalog and platform. We’re looking for a leader who understands the details of royalty administration but can also see the bigger picture: how to build scalable processes, navigate complex deals, and create an exceptional foundation for every catalog that joins Create Music Group .

Responsibilities

• Own contract-to-system royalty interpretation company-wide: rates, splits, territories, escalators, cross-collateralization, recoupment, and defensible workarounds where a platform cannot implement a term literally.

• Own the Royalties Readiness Gate for incoming acquisitions. Issue the go/no-go recommendation on every acquisition before it enters statement processing, with peer review from the Senior Manager, Royalty Accounting & Operations.

• Own the handoff packet standard for incoming acquisitions. Every acquisition handoff states plainly what is final, what is assumed, and what remains open. No acquisition transfers to operations without one.

• Lead contractual royalty obligation analysis for acquisitions, including a written risk/reward recommendation on onboarding methodology - migrate the label into our systems, or leave it on its existing platform.

• Represent Royalties in M&A diligence from LOI. Own the royalty section of the diligence memo and the list of closing conditions Royalties depends on.

• Own the team's project portfolio: expense validation tooling, bulk and automated ingestion of expenses, sales, and contracts, the M&A onboarding checklist, and automated metadata, contract, and payor template generation derived from statement analysis.

• Own role-based access and configuration governance across all royalty systems. Define who may create clients, update splits, and alter contract terms - and enforce it.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
About HeyMax

HeyMax turns everyday spending into travel. Users earn Max Miles on the things they already buy, and redeem them for flights, hotels, and experiences worldwide. Founded in 2023, we're live in Singapore and Hong Kong - and building toward a product that works for anyone, anywhere in the world.
The role - a mini lab inside HeyMax

You'll run a growth and expansion design lab: a small, autonomous unit with one mandate - grow HeyMax 's user base, anywhere in the world. That means the full growth surface: how new users discover and activate, how existing users deepen and refer, and how the experience flexes for markets and users we haven't designed for yet. You operate like a startup within the startup - pick the highest-leverage problem, ship an experiment, read the data, decide what's next.
What you'll own

•
Global activation - the entire journey from first touch to first value moment, designed to work for any user in any market from day one. This is the engine that lets HeyMax launch a country without rebuilding the product.

•
One experience, every market - an adaptive design system where the product reconfigures itself around user state and market maturity. You're not designing screens per country; you're designing the rules that make one product serve a hundred markets.

•
Compounding growth loops - referral, sharing, and re-engagement mechanics built to scale across borders. Every experiment you ship becomes reusable infrastructure for the next market.

•
The lab's playbook - you set the growth agenda, run the experiment portfolio, and build the repeatable expansion playbook the whole company will run on.

Who you are

• 5+ years consumer product design, with real growth work - you've owned an activation or acquisition funnel metric, not just designed alongside one.

• Systems thinker: you design state machines, not screens. "What does this surface look like with 1 partner / 10 partners" is a question you ask before drawing anything.

• AI-native: AI tools are your default for prototyping, research synthesis, and copy variants - you move at lab speed because of it. Bonus: you've designed agent or copilot patterns.

• Comfortable with the ambiguity of a market you can't visit - you design research-cheap ways to learn (fake-door tests, concierge MVPs, remote unmoderated tests).

title: Solutions Architect - EMEA
description:
About Us

AI coding is the largest use case of enterprise AI adoption today, as is evident from the success of Anthropic on Claude Code, Cursor’s $60B exit to SpaceX, and Cognition’s $48B valuation.

The bottleneck now has moved from code generation to security and safety - AI agents write code faster than any team can review it, and over 65% of the lines of code produced by them are insecure. Vulnerabilities are piling up 16x faster than companies can fix them, and adversaries are able to exploit these new vulnerabilities within hours.

AURI by Endor Labs closes that gap. It runs inside the harness where coding agents work, through hooks, skills and MCP, so the controls sit outside the model and every agent action is visible. Underneath is our patented code context graph, which maps code, open source, containers and infrastructure. It shows which vulnerabilities can actually be reached and exploited, then delivers fixes that won’t break the application. Security teams get evidence instead of noise, and developers get fixes instead of tickets.

The companies building AI trust us to secure it - our customers include OpenAI, SpaceX, DoorDash, Dropbox, Atlassian, MongoDB, Snowflake, Robinhood and Peloton to name a few.

Endor Labs is the third company from Founder & CEO Varun Badhwar, who built Prisma Cloud, the platform that helped define cloud security, from $0 to $300M ARR at Palo Alto Networks. We’ve raised $163M from Lightspeed, Coatue, DFJ Growth, Salesforce Ventures and Dell Technologies Capital.

Software runs everything around our lives today - banking, hospitals, airports and power grids. AI now writes more of it every day, and our mission is to make sure the world can trust that software. Come build that future with us.

title: Product Engineer / Builder
description:
WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

Manufacturing is Europe’s backbone, and it’s under pressure. More than half of manufacturing cost is decided in procurement, yet the function still runs on Excel.

Tacto is building the intelligence layer between bits and atoms, connecting the digital world of engineering with the physical world of manufacturing. It’s how AI gets into the real economy.

WHAT WE MEAN BY BUILDER

Because of AI, we only hire Builders. No specialized roles.

A Builder takes a messy, unclear problem and owns it from start to finish. That goes for business problems, not just customer problems. You decide what’s worth doing, make the case for it, test the risky parts early, and see it through until it pays off. When something works, you share it so everyone gets better.

Builder is the what. The Tacto Engineer is the how. It’s our engineering practice and the bar we hold each other to.
Wear the customer’s shoes. Ship fast, finish fully. Sweat the details. Get 1% better every week. No lone wolves. Use AI as leverage, not a crutch.

- You’ve built AI features into a product, or you’re obsessively learning how.

- You want to be in a room full of people who are fired up about what they’re building.

 

STACK

Python, FastAPI, Postgres, and ClickHouse on the backend. React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, and Storybook on the frontend. GitHub, Linear, and Figma for everything around it. For AI, whatever ships fastest.

 

HOW WE WORK

We’re in our Munich office four days a week, with 100+ people building together every day. We measure outcomes, not hours. Trust is high and feedback is direct.
Competitive salary and meaningful equity. 26 + 4 vacation days, Wellpass fitness membership, JobRad bike leasing, company pension plan, and a childcare (Kita) subsidy.

title: Vice President of Information Technology
description:
Established in 1956, Jacuzzi® Group operates through two distinct divisions: Jacuzzi® Spa, a global leader in premium hot tubs, swim spas, and saunas-and Jacuzzi® Bath, which provides specialized bathing solutions and national remodeling expertise. Jacuzzi Bath is the fastest growing division focusing on the highest standard of customer satisfaction.
We are seeking a visionary Vice President of Information Technology to join our leadership team during an exciting period of growth. This newly created leadership role will be instrumental in defining and executing an IT strategy that drives operational efficiency. The Vice President of Information Technology will be responsible for building and scaling our IT organization from the ground up, delivering technology solutions that drive growth and providing an exceptional customer experience. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in managing large-scale IT projects, implementing cutting-edge technologies, and leading teams in a fast-paced environment.
Key Responsibilities for the Vice President of Information Technology:
Strategic Leadership

• Develop and execute an IT strategy aligned with company objectives.

• Build a shared-services IT model that effectively supports multiple business units.

• Collaborate with leaders across Operations, Manufacturing, Sales, Marketing, Finance, HR, Supply Chain, and Customer Service.

• Translate business needs into technology solutions and communicate technical concepts in clear business terms.

• Provide regular updates to executive leadership on IT performance, projects, risks, and strategic initiatives.

IT Leadership & Team Development

• Design the IT organization for Jacuzzi Bath: define the roles, structure, and reporting lines needed to support both manufacturing and remodeling.

• Create a phased hiring plan that matches the growth of the business, so the team scales as the division does.

• Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing IT team.

• Establish IT key performance indicators.

• Determine the right balance between internal resources and outsourced services.

• Promote a customer-focused approach where IT is viewed as a trusted business partner.

Process Improvement Initiatives

• Oversee IT service management processes, including incident, change, and problem management.

• Standardize systems and processes while reducing manual work and inefficiencies.

• Partner with business leaders to improve and automate key operational workflows.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, or similar methodologies.

Systems, Data & Technology

• Manage enterprise applications, including ERP, CRM, financial, HRIS, manufacturing, and project management systems.

• Lead system implementations, upgrades, and integrations.

• Establish strong data governance, reporting, and analytics capabilities to support business decision-making.

• Ensure systems are reliable, scalable, and aligned with organizational needs.

Financial & Vendor Management

• Develop and manage the IT budget and long-term technology investment plans.

• Negotiate and manage vendor contracts, service agreements, and strategic partnerships.

• Monitor IT spending and identify opportunities for cost savings and operational efficiency.

• Other duties as assigned.

Compensation for Vice President of Information Technology:
$200,000 + (Based on experience) + potential bonus
Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field. Master's degree or MBA preferred.

• 10+ years of progressive IT leadership experience at lease 5 years in an executive position.

• Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, PMP, ITIL, or Lean Six Sigma.

• Experience supporting manufacturing, construction, building products, home services, distribution, or related industries preferred.

• Experience in private-equity-backed organizations preferred.

• Strong experience leading ERP and CRM implementations
